# Style API Reference

Complete reference for Echo Chamber style families and style constructors. Inherited fluent setters are shown on each concrete style so you can see the complete visual API available to that style.

---

## Style families

### EchoPanelStyleFamily
{: #echo-panel-style-family .api-type-title }

Creates a panel style family.

```gml
new EchoPanelStyleFamily()
```

#### Methods

<table class="api-methods"><thead><tr><th>Method</th><th>What it does</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-panel-style-family-default"><code>Default()</code></a></td><td>Returns the live default panel style. This returns the actual default style, not a copy. If you change it, every control using the default style for that family will see the change.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-panel-style-family-set"><code>Set()</code></a></td><td>Stores or replaces a named panel style variant. The key is the same string you pass to <code>SetStyleKey(...)</code>, <code>SetStyleKeyHeader(...)</code>, <code>SetStyleKeyChromeButton(...)</code>, or another style-key setter.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-panel-style-family-get"><code>Get()</code></a></td><td>Returns an existing named panel style variant, or undefined if it doesn&#x27;t exist.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-panel-style-family-has"><code>Has()</code></a></td><td>Returns whether a named panel style variant exists.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-panel-style-family-remove"><code>Remove()</code></a></td><td>Removes a named panel style variant if it exists.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-panel-style-family-clear-variants"><code>ClearVariants()</code></a></td><td>Removes all named panel style variants. This removes named variants only. It doesn&#x27;t clear the default style.</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

## Windows and layout

### EchoWindowChromeButtonStyle
{: #echo-window-chrome-button-style .api-type-title }

Creates an optional override style for a window button. The active state is used for chrome buttons that represent an enabled window state. For example, a pinned window can use the active icon colour for its pin button.

```gml
new EchoWindowChromeButtonStyle()
```

#### Methods

<div class="api-method-group-title">Style-specific</div>
<table class="api-methods"><tbody>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-chrome-button-style-set-font"><code>SetFont()</code></a></td><td>Sets the chrome button font.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-chrome-button-style-set-active-bg-colour"><code>SetActiveBgColour()</code></a></td><td>Sets all background corner colours. Omitted corners use the top-left colour.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-chrome-button-style-set-active-border-colour"><code>SetActiveBorderColour()</code></a></td><td>Sets all border corner colours. Omitted corners use the top-left colour.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-chrome-button-style-set-active-text-colour"><code>SetActiveTextColour()</code></a></td><td>Sets the active text colour.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-chrome-button-style-set-active-bg-alpha"><code>SetActiveBgAlpha()</code></a></td><td>Sets the active background alpha.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-chrome-button-style-set-active-border-alpha"><code>SetActiveBorderAlpha()</code></a></td><td>Sets the active border alpha.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-chrome-button-style-set-active-text-alpha"><code>SetActiveTextAlpha()</code></a></td><td>Sets the active text alpha.</td></tr>

### EchoWindowStyle
{: #echo-window-style .api-type-title }

Creates an optional override style for a window body. Clamp margin controls how close a draggable window is allowed to get to the canvas edge before Echo Chamber pulls it back. It&#x27;s a safety margin, not visual padding.

```gml
new EchoWindowStyle()
```

#### Methods

<div class="api-method-group-title">Style-specific</div>
<table class="api-methods"><tbody>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-clamp-margin"><code>SetClampMargin()</code></a></td><td>Sets all clamp margins to the same value.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-clamp-margin-x"><code>SetClampMarginX()</code></a></td><td>Sets the horizontal clamp margins.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-clamp-margin-y"><code>SetClampMarginY()</code></a></td><td>Sets the vertical clamp margins.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-clamp-margin-left"><code>SetClampMarginLeft()</code></a></td><td>Sets the left clamp margin.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-clamp-margin-top"><code>SetClampMarginTop()</code></a></td><td>Sets the top clamp margin.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-clamp-margin-right"><code>SetClampMarginRight()</code></a></td><td>Sets the right clamp margin.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-clamp-margin-bottom"><code>SetClampMarginBottom()</code></a></td><td>Sets the bottom clamp margin.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-clamp-margin-ltrb"><code>SetClampMarginLTRB()</code></a></td><td>Sets all clamp margins explicitly.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-titlebar-visible"><code>SetTitlebarVisible()</code></a></td><td>Sets whether the titlebar is visible.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-resize-grip-size"><code>SetResizeGripSize()</code></a></td><td>Sets the resize grip size.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-minimized-height"><code>SetMinimizedHeight()</code></a></td><td>Sets the minimized window height.</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

<div class="api-method-group-title">Padding</div>
<table class="api-methods"><tbody>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-padding"><code>SetPadding()</code></a></td><td>Sets the padding.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-padding-x"><code>SetPaddingX()</code></a></td><td>Sets horizontal padding.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-padding-y"><code>SetPaddingY()</code></a></td><td>Sets vertical padding.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-padding-left"><code>SetPaddingLeft()</code></a></td><td>Sets the padding left.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-padding-top"><code>SetPaddingTop()</code></a></td><td>Sets the padding top.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-padding-right"><code>SetPaddingRight()</code></a></td><td>Sets the padding right.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-padding-bottom"><code>SetPaddingBottom()</code></a></td><td>Sets the padding bottom.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-padding-ltrb"><code>SetPaddingLTRB()</code></a></td><td>Sets left, top, right, and bottom padding.</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

<div class="api-method-group-title">Frame</div>
<table class="api-methods"><tbody>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-bg-colour"><code>SetBgColour()</code></a></td><td>Sets the background colour. Frame styles use one colour for the entire surface, unlike stateful box styles which support four corner colours.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-style-set-border-colour"><code>SetBorderColour()</code></a></td><td>Sets the border colour. Frame styles use one colour for the entire surface, unlike stateful box styles which support four corner colours.</td></tr>

</tbody></table>

### EchoWindowHeaderStyle
{: #echo-window-header-style .api-type-title }

Creates an optional override style for a window header. The <code>SpriteSet</code> methods expect a sprite with state subimages. Subimage <code>0</code> is the normal icon. Later subimages can provide hover, pressed, and disabled versions.

```gml
new EchoWindowHeaderStyle()
```

#### Methods

<div class="api-method-group-title">Style-specific</div>
<table class="api-methods"><tbody>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-header-style-set-font"><code>SetFont()</code></a></td><td>Sets the header font.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-header-style-set-text-colour"><code>SetTextColour()</code></a></td><td>Sets the header text colour.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-header-style-set-text-alpha"><code>SetTextAlpha()</code></a></td><td>Sets the header text alpha.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-header-style-set-disabled-text-colour"><code>SetDisabledTextColour()</code></a></td><td>Sets the disabled header text colour.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-header-style-set-disabled-text-alpha"><code>SetDisabledTextAlpha()</code></a></td><td>Sets the disabled header text alpha.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-header-style-set-text-align"><code>SetTextAlign()</code></a></td><td>Sets the header text alignment.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-window-header-style-set-height"><code>SetHeight()</code></a></td><td>Sets the header height.</td></tr>

### EchoPanelStyle
{: #echo-panel-style .api-type-title }

Creates an optional override style for a panel. <code>SetGap(...)</code> is the simple &quot;space between controls&quot; setting. Use <code>SetGapX(...)</code> and <code>SetGapY(...)</code> only when horizontal and vertical spacing need to differ.

```gml
new EchoPanelStyle()
```

### EchoPopupStyle
{: #echo-popup-style .api-type-title }

Creates an optional override style for popups. Anchor gap is the distance between the control that opened the popup and the popup itself.

```gml
new EchoPopupStyle()
```

#### Methods

<div class="api-method-group-title">Style-specific</div>
<table class="api-methods"><tbody>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-popup-style-set-header-bg-colour"><code>SetHeaderBgColour()</code></a></td><td>Sets the popup header background colour.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-popup-style-set-header-alpha"><code>SetHeaderAlpha()</code></a></td><td>Sets the popup header alpha.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-popup-style-set-anchor-gap"><code>SetAnchorGap()</code></a></td><td>Sets the popup anchor gap.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-popup-style-set-viewport-margin"><code>SetViewportMargin()</code></a></td><td>Sets all popup viewport margins to the same value.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-popup-style-set-viewport-margin-x"><code>SetViewportMarginX()</code></a></td><td>Sets the left and right popup viewport margins.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-popup-style-set-viewport-margin-y"><code>SetViewportMarginY()</code></a></td><td>Sets the top and bottom popup viewport margins.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-popup-style-set-viewport-margin-left"><code>SetViewportMarginLeft()</code></a></td><td>Sets the left popup viewport margin.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-popup-style-set-viewport-margin-top"><code>SetViewportMarginTop()</code></a></td><td>Sets the top popup viewport margin.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-popup-style-set-viewport-margin-right"><code>SetViewportMarginRight()</code></a></td><td>Sets the right popup viewport margin.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-popup-style-set-viewport-margin-bottom"><code>SetViewportMarginBottom()</code></a></td><td>Sets the bottom popup viewport margin.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-popup-style-set-viewport-margin-ltrb"><code>SetViewportMarginLTRB()</code></a></td><td>Sets all popup viewport margins explicitly.</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

<div class="api-method-group-title">Frame</div>
<table class="api-methods"><tbody>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-popup-style-set-bg-colour"><code>SetBgColour()</code></a></td><td>Sets the background colour. Frame styles use one colour for the entire surface, unlike stateful box styles which support four corner colours.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-popup-style-set-border-colour"><code>SetBorderColour()</code></a></td><td>Sets the border colour. Frame styles use one colour for the entire surface, unlike stateful box styles which support four corner colours.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-popup-style-set-bg-alpha"><code>SetBgAlpha()</code></a></td><td>Sets background opacity.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-popup-style-set-border-alpha"><code>SetBorderAlpha()</code></a></td><td>Sets border opacity.</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

### EchoScrollbarStyle
{: #echo-scrollbar-style .api-type-title }

Creates an optional override style for scrollbars. The track is the full scrollbar rail. The handle is the part the user drags.

```gml
new EchoScrollbarStyle()
```

## Text, lists, and display

### EchoListRowStyle
{: #echo-list-row-style .api-type-title }

List row style used by list and dropdown rows. List rows have more states than a simple button because a row can be normal, hovered, selected, pressed, or disabled. Selection means &quot;this row is currently chosen&quot;, while hover means &quot;the mouse is currently over this row&quot;.

```gml
new EchoListRowStyle()
```

### EchoContextMenuStyle
{: #echo-context-menu-style .api-type-title }

Creates an optional override style for context menus. The viewport margin keeps a menu away from the edge of the screen. This matters when a user right-clicks close to the edge and the menu needs room to remain visible.

```gml
new EchoContextMenuStyle()
```

### EchoTextBlockStyle
{: #echo-text-block-style .api-type-title }

Text block control style. Wrapping only matters when the text is too wide for the available space. <code>SetFillAvailableWhileWrapping(true)</code> lets the text block use the available row width instead of measuring only its current text.

```gml
new EchoTextBlockStyle()
```

### EchoLabelStyle
{: #echo-label-style .api-type-title }

Label style used by controls and panels. Labels can be automatic. In that mode, Echo Chamber decides whether a label should sit to the left of a control, above the control, or be hidden for that layout. This is why the label style includes minimum width, maximum width, and maximum ratio settings.

```gml
new EchoLabelStyle()
```

### EchoTooltipStyle
{: #echo-tooltip-style .api-type-title }

Creates an optional override style for tooltips. Viewport margin keeps the tooltip away from the canvas edge so it doesn&#x27;t get clipped offscreen.

```gml
new EchoTooltipStyle()
```

#### Methods

<div class="api-method-group-title">Style-specific</div>
<table class="api-methods"><tbody>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-tooltip-style-set-font"><code>SetFont()</code></a></td><td>Sets the tooltip font.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-tooltip-style-set-text-colour"><code>SetTextColour()</code></a></td><td>Sets the tooltip text colour.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-tooltip-style-set-text-alpha"><code>SetTextAlpha()</code></a></td><td>Sets the tooltip text alpha.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-tooltip-style-set-max-width"><code>SetMaxWidth()</code></a></td><td>Sets the tooltip max width.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-tooltip-style-set-anchor-offset-x"><code>SetAnchorOffsetX()</code></a></td><td>Sets the tooltip anchor X offset.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-tooltip-style-set-anchor-offset-y"><code>SetAnchorOffsetY()</code></a></td><td>Sets the tooltip anchor Y offset.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-tooltip-style-set-viewport-margin"><code>SetViewportMargin()</code></a></td><td>Sets all tooltip viewport margins to the same value.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-tooltip-style-set-viewport-margin-x"><code>SetViewportMarginX()</code></a></td><td>Sets the left and right tooltip viewport margins.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-tooltip-style-set-viewport-margin-y"><code>SetViewportMarginY()</code></a></td><td>Sets the top and bottom tooltip viewport margins.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-tooltip-style-set-viewport-margin-left"><code>SetViewportMarginLeft()</code></a></td><td>Sets the left tooltip viewport margin.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-tooltip-style-set-viewport-margin-top"><code>SetViewportMarginTop()</code></a></td><td>Sets the top tooltip viewport margin.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-tooltip-style-set-viewport-margin-right"><code>SetViewportMarginRight()</code></a></td><td>Sets the right tooltip viewport margin.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-tooltip-style-set-viewport-margin-bottom"><code>SetViewportMarginBottom()</code></a></td><td>Sets the bottom tooltip viewport margin.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-tooltip-style-set-viewport-margin-ltrb"><code>SetViewportMarginLTRB()</code></a></td><td>Sets all tooltip viewport margins explicitly.</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

### EchoToastStyle
{: #echo-toast-style .api-type-title }

Creates an optional override style for toasts. Toasts are short-lived messages shown by the Echo Chamber root. They are useful for &quot;saved&quot;, &quot;copied&quot;, or &quot;layout restored&quot; style feedback.

```gml
new EchoToastStyle()
```

#### Methods

<div class="api-method-group-title">Style-specific</div>
<table class="api-methods"><tbody>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-toast-style-set-font"><code>SetFont()</code></a></td><td>Sets the toast font.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-toast-style-set-text-colour"><code>SetTextColour()</code></a></td><td>Sets the toast text colour.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-toast-style-set-text-alpha"><code>SetTextAlpha()</code></a></td><td>Sets the toast text alpha.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-toast-style-set-max-width"><code>SetMaxWidth()</code></a></td><td>Sets the toast max width.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-toast-style-set-viewport-margin"><code>SetViewportMargin()</code></a></td><td>Sets all toast viewport margins to the same value.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-toast-style-set-viewport-margin-x"><code>SetViewportMarginX()</code></a></td><td>Sets the left and right toast viewport margins.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-toast-style-set-viewport-margin-y"><code>SetViewportMarginY()</code></a></td><td>Sets the top and bottom toast viewport margins.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-toast-style-set-viewport-margin-left"><code>SetViewportMarginLeft()</code></a></td><td>Sets the left toast viewport margin.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-toast-style-set-viewport-margin-top"><code>SetViewportMarginTop()</code></a></td><td>Sets the top toast viewport margin.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-toast-style-set-viewport-margin-right"><code>SetViewportMarginRight()</code></a></td><td>Sets the right toast viewport margin.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-toast-style-set-viewport-margin-bottom"><code>SetViewportMarginBottom()</code></a></td><td>Sets the bottom toast viewport margin.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-toast-style-set-viewport-margin-ltrb"><code>SetViewportMarginLTRB()</code></a></td><td>Sets all toast viewport margins explicitly.</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

### EchoSeparatorStyle
{: #echo-separator-style .api-type-title }

Separator control style. A separator doesn&#x27;t behave like a button. It&#x27;s mostly a visual divider, so its style is intentionally small.

```gml
new EchoSeparatorStyle()
```

#### Methods

<div class="api-method-group-title">Style-specific</div>

<tr><td><a href="#echo-separator-style-set-line-colour"><code>SetLineColour()</code></a></td><td>Sets the separator line colour.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-separator-style-set-line-alpha"><code>SetLineAlpha()</code></a></td><td>Sets the separator line alpha.</td></tr>
<tr><td><a href="#echo-separator-style-set-disabled-line-colour"><code>SetDisabledLineColour()</code></a></td><td>Sets the disabled separator line colour.</td></tr>

<tr><td><a href="#echo-separator-style-set-thickness"><code>SetThickness()</code></a></td><td>Sets the separator thickness.</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

## Interactive controls

### EchoButtonStyle
{: #echo-button-style .api-type-title }

Button control style.

```gml
new EchoButtonStyle()
```

#### Methods

<div class="api-method-group-title">Style-specific</div>

### EchoColorButtonStyle
{: #echo-color-button-style .api-type-title }

Color button control style. The swatch is the little colour preview box shown on the button. Value text is the optional written value, such as an RGB readout.

```gml
new EchoColorButtonStyle()
```

### EchoToggleStyle
{: #echo-toggle-style .api-type-title }

Toggles control style. The &quot;on&quot; colour is used when the toggle value is <code>true</code>. The &quot;off&quot; colour is used when the toggle value is <code>false</code>.

```gml
new EchoToggleStyle()
```

### EchoDropdownStyle
{: #echo-dropdown-style .api-type-title }

Creates an optional override style for dropdowns. The overlay is the floating options list that appears when the dropdown opens. Search styles only matter when the dropdown is configured with a searchable overlay.

```gml
new EchoDropdownStyle()
```

### EchoTextInputStyle
{: #echo-text-input-style .api-type-title }

Creates an optional override style for text inputs. Active means the input currently has keyboard focus. Readonly means the user can see the value but can&#x27;t edit it. Invalid is used when validation reports a problem.

```gml
new EchoTextInputStyle()
```

### EchoTextBoxOverlayStyle
{: #echo-text-box-overlay-style .api-type-title }

Creates an optional override style for the text box editor overlay. The dim colour is drawn behind the editor overlay. It helps the editor feel separate from the rest of the debug UI while the user is editing a longer text value.

```gml
new EchoTextBoxOverlayStyle()
```

#### Methods

<div class="api-method-group-title">Style-specific</div>
<table class="api-methods"><tbody>

<tr><td><a href="#echo-text-box-overlay-style-set-viewport-margin"><code>SetViewportMargin()</code></a></td><td>Sets the viewport edge margin used when sizing and clamping the editor overlay.</td></tr>

### EchoSliderStyle
{: #echo-slider-style .api-type-title }

Creates an optional override style for sliders. Track background is the full slider line. Track fill is the filled portion that represents the current value. Knob is the draggable handle.

```gml
new EchoSliderStyle()
```

#### Methods

<div class="api-method-group-title">Style-specific</div>
<table class="api-methods"><tbody>

### EchoColorPickerStyle
{: #echo-color-picker-style .api-type-title }

Creates an optional override style for the color picker. The colour picker is a small interface inside a popup, so its style controls both general popup layout and several inner editor pieces.

```gml
new EchoColorPickerStyle()
```

#### Methods
